english.title: Intentionally alter a document required to be produced by notice under section 109 of the Enterprise Act 2002
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally altered a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..) which you had been required to produce by a notice issued under section 109 of the Enterprise Act 2002 on the **(..SPECIFY DATE OF NOTICE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(5) and (7) of the Enterprise Act 2002.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence has been replaced as of 1st January 2025 with the offence under section 116A of the Enterprise Act 2002 (H101975).
(ii) Section 110(6) of the Act provides that a person does not commit an offence under section 109(5) in relation to any act which constitutes a failure to comply with a notice under section 109 if the Commission has proceeded against that person by imposing a penalty under section 111 in relation to that failure.
